description: VDD Phase 7b: Prepare one task for implementation — loads constitution, spec, plan, and contracts and returns the implementation instruction plus the impact-chain commit-message format. Read-only; the tool writes nothing — the host agent performs the code edits, verification, and commit. Pass taskId (e.g. "TASK-003") from the task returned by vdd_get_next_task. Run one task at a time, after vdd_get_next_task; for read-only inspection of tasks use vdd_get_next_task instead. Parameter relationships: taskId comes from vdd_get_next_task (format TASK-###); projectRoot must match the root used by earlier phases.

actionItemId.description: Tactical action item ID, format A-### (e.g., 'A-001'); must be an item id from vdd/tactics.md

artifactFiles.description: Map of vdd/-relative artifact path → full file text, for serverless validate/drift detection where the tool cannot read the filesystem

availableTools.description: MCP/tool names available to the host agent (e.g., ['brave-search','perplexity','context7','gh_grep','playwright','filesystem'])

feature.description: Feature name: the vdd/specs/<feature>/ directory, kebab-case (e.g., 'user-auth'); must reference a directory created earlier by vdd_specify

projectRoot.description: Project root: directory that constitution.md and the vdd/ folder are written to and resolved against. Relative paths resolve from the current working directory; keep the same value across every phase.

researchFindings.description: Consolidated research subagent findings to synthesize into strategy.md (effect only on the second strategize call)

taskId.description: Task ID to implement, format TASK-### (e.g., 'TASK-003'); must be an id listed in the feature's tasks.md (see vdd_get_next_task)

name: vdd_implement
title: Implement Task
